title: Connect App Store: it didn't connect
summary: The same confirmation after App Store Connect refused the key: an inline danger callout says nothing changed, why (the Example Audio team key has the Developer role, which can't read in-app purchases or set up store notifications) and the fix (give it the App Manager role in Users and Access → Integrations), with Open App Store Connect and Try again.
compare: The dialog stays open with the same facts; the error takes the consequences' place as a danger callout with role=alert, never as a toast.

The callout title says the outcome first ('The App Store didn't connect. Nothing changed.'); the text names the cause in App Store Connect's own words (Developer role, App Manager role, Users and Access → Integrations) and the one fix.
Open App Store Connect is a deep link; Try again (primary, with a refresh icon) repeats the same request with the same idempotency key and takes focus.

The other failures use the same slot and shape: App Store Connect didn't answer ('Nothing changed. Try again in a few minutes.'); the key can't see com.example.djdl because DJDL is in another team ('Add that team's key in Platform → Connections'); Apple hasn't verified the key yet (A-18k), where the row offers the human steps instead of this dialog.
Phone: the same bottom sheet; the callout's link stays under its text.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

findings.issue: A retry would fail again without a change at the store.
findings.resolution: Retitled 'Couldn't connect the App Store'; 'Open App Store Connect' is the primary action; Cancel is ghost.
